definitions.explanation: Juice extracted from fruit. Commonly seen on beverage labels and in food-related contexts.

examples.japanese: {果汁|かじゅう}100%⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{果汁|かじゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っています→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Does this drink contain fruit juice?

examples.japanese: {搾|しぼ}りたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果汁|かじゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦カクテル→カクテル：10802_kakuteru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a cocktail with freshly squeezed fruit juice.

notes:
{果汁|かじゅう} is the formal/technical term for fruit juice, commonly seen on product labels and packaging rather than in casual conversation.

FORMS:
{果|か} (fruit) + {汁|じゅう} (juice, liquid).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {果汁|かじゅう}100%: 100% fruit juice (common label)
- {果汁|かじゅう}{入|い}り: containing fruit juice
- {搾|しぼ}りたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果汁|かじゅう}: freshly squeezed juice
- {果汁|かじゅう}⟦{飲料|いんりょう}→飲料：03011_inryou⟧: fruit juice beverage

USAGE:
In Japan, beverage labels must state the {果汁|かじゅう} percentage. Products with less than 100% are labeled as {果汁|かじゅう}○○% or {果汁|かじゅう}{入|い}り.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {果汁|かじゅう}: fruit juice (formal, label term)
- ⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧: juice (casual everyday word; in Japanese, can also mean any sweet drink, not just fruit juice)
- ⟦{果実|かじつ}→果実：00146_kajitsu⟧: fruit (the whole fruit, not the juice)
